A badge can show a changing picture.

Small badges with pictures of favorite characters have become popular with some collectors in China. People often put these metal badges on their bags. Now, electronic badges offer a new version of this hobby. Instead of a printed picture, they have a small screen.

Users can change the screen to show different pictures, short videos or moving images. One user put a photograph of her dog on a badge. Another liked being able to change pictures without carrying a large collection of metal badges.

However, people do not all feel the same about the change. Some still enjoy collecting physical badges and meeting other fans who recognize them. A changing screen may be useful, but it does not automatically create the same feeling. The story shows how technology can change a familiar hobby.
